parties.respondent: M/S Om Prakash Brick Kiln Owner

summary: Royalty on brick earth extraction; ownership presumption under Section 42, Punjab Land Revenue Act, 1887; pre-1871 record of rights favours State; non-joinder of landowners; civil court jurisdiction; royalty levy under Mines and Minerals Act, 1957; High Court reappreciation error; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Mines and Minerals (Regulation and Development) Act, 1957 s.3(e), s.15
Punjab Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1964 Rule 54A, Rule 3
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court and First Appellate Court decrees restored; royalty levy upheld.
